answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.786, which fits system-prompted (0.79-0.82). Quantized and fine-tuned models diverge later (10-17 and 5.5-8 tokens). Logit shift is large (KL 0.429, top-1 agreement 0.865, TV 0.146, DiFR gap 0.529), at or above the system-prompted range. Activations match too: onset layer 8, layer-16 relative L2 0.478, layer-32 0.501, cosine 0.849, effective rank 2.77, size ratio 0.972, raw-score shift ÷ TV 3.7, activation-to-logit ratio 1.2. The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the expected 31.7-64.0, which is the main mismatch. That spike is also too small for a typical fine-tune, but the rest of the profile (steep rise, plateau, low rank, shrinking size) rules out fine-tuned and quantized.
